bug_semantics: With SaveLogs configured, an authenticated caller able to invoke StartAction can supply UniqueTrackingId containing slash and .. segments. The API copies that value into ExecutionRequest.TrackingID; the executor accepts any nonempty, nonduplicate string, copies it into InternalLogEntry.ExecutionTrackingID, interpolates it into the persisted log filename, and path.Join cleans the traversal before ioutil.WriteFile/os.WriteFile creates the .yaml results and .log output files outside the configured log directory. Thus the caller can select traversal-resolved destinations (subject to the fixed suffixes, generated metadata/output contents, and OliveTin process permissions).
flaw_origin: The SaveLogs disk sink was first written in the sole commit of PR #300, fe991045b5bd9c7fbe57bb83a12a56deca68ef06: it added SaveLogs configuration plus stepSaveLog, which embedded the already user-controlled, unvalidated ExecutionTrackingID in a filename passed through path.Join to file writes. GitHub put the identical change on the mainline as squash commit 8fd98874e2b62c693cf2ab086f6c006020507760; both objects have parent dc6f6c2896f953d2f55421df80da09bdd1926ec4 and tree abda7c392f104f1679db3dbc76bd54cea64909a5, so the PR member is the smallest reconstructable BIC rather than the squash aggregate. The later 100% path move ff31abe66cfd46f8cccca00ad708529e4d920144 from internal/executor to service/internal/executor did not originate the flaw.
ai_marker: Absent on the BIC commit object. `git cat-file -p fe991045b5bd9c7fbe57bb83a12a56deca68ef06` shows author and committer `jamesread <contact@jread.com>` and only the message `feature: Save logs! #174`; there is no AI/bot identity and no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, or other AI trailer.
evidence: Advisory GHSA-364q-w7vh-vhpc/CVE-2026-31817 identifies UniqueTrackingId -> ExecutionRequest.TrackingID -> filename -> path.Join -> file-write and references direct fix 2f77000de44f65690f257e3cf8e2c8462b0e74c7 and release 3000.11.2. Reproduce the origin in the validated clone with `git log --all --reverse -S'func stepSaveLog' -- internal/executor/executor.go service/internal/executor/executor.go` and `git log -L 466,474:internal/executor/executor.go 8fd98874e2b62c693cf2ab086f6c006020507760`: mainline first adds the sink at 8fd98874e2b62c693cf2ab086f6c006020507760. `git show 8fd98874e2b62c693cf2ab086f6c006020507760 -- internal/config/config.go internal/executor/executor.go` shows the new SaveLogs fields, stepSaveLog filename interpolation, path.Join, and two writes. GitHub's first-party `https://api.github.com/repos/OliveTin/OliveTin/pulls/300/commits` lists exactly one PR member, fe991045b5bd9c7fbe57bb83a12a56deca68ef06. `git rev-parse fe991045b5bd9c7fbe57bb83a12a56deca68ef06^{tree} 8fd98874e2b62c693cf2ab086f6c006020507760^{tree}` returns abda7c392f104f1679db3dbc76bd54cea64909a5 twice, and resolving both parents returns dc6f6c2896f953d2f55421df80da09bdd1926ec4 twice, proving exact one-member squash decomposition. Parent absence is direct: `git grep -n -E 'stepSaveLog|saveLogResults|ResultsDirectory|OutputDirectory' dc6f6c2896f953d2f55421df80da09bdd1926ec4 -- internal` has no matches, while `git grep -n -E 'TrackingID:.*UniqueTrackingId|req\.TrackingID == ""' dc6f6c2896f953d2f55421df80da09bdd1926ec4 -- internal` shows the pre-existing unvalidated source at internal/grpcapi/grpcApi.go:67 and acceptance at internal/executor/executor.go:146. `git describe --tags --abbrev=0 8fd98874e2b62c693cf2ab086f6c006020507760^` returns 2024.04.261, while `git tag --contains 8fd98874e2b62c693cf2ab086f6c006020507760 --sort=creatordate` begins with 2024.04.28, establishing the feature's first affected release boundary. `git show 2f77000de44f65690f257e3cf8e2c8462b0e74c7 -- service/internal/executor/executor.go` adds a 36-character hex/hyphen validation predicate and replaces invalid IDs with UUIDs. `git grep` at tag 3000.11.1 still shows `if isDuplicate || req.TrackingID == ""`, whereas tag 3000.11.2 shows isValidTrackingID and `if isDuplicate || !isValidTrackingID(req.TrackingID)`. `git rev-parse b03af0e2eca3` resolves the advisory's first-patched pseudo-version commit to b03af0e2eca3d564abd5604868069f94dc798de0, tagged 3000.11.2 and containing 2f77000de44f65690f257e3cf8e2c8462b0e74c7. Finally, the BIC-only `git cat-file -p fe991045b5bd9c7fbe57bb83a12a56deca68ef06` provides the marker check quoted in ai_marker.
reasoning: The unsafe API value existed before the BIC, but without SaveLogs there was no filesystem sink; therefore the earlier tracking-ID commits did not yet create this vulnerability. fe991045b5bd9c7fbe57bb83a12a56deca68ef06 is the atomic PR commit that completed the exploitable chain, its parent directly lacks all SaveLogs sink/configuration symbols, and the mainline squash has the same parent and tree. The vulnerability persisted through the later directory move and releases from 2024.04.28 through 3000.11.1. Direct security commit 2f77000de44f65690f257e3cf8e2c8462b0e74c7 closes the attacker-controlled path component by accepting only bounded hex/hyphen IDs and generating a UUID for all other input; 3000.11.2 is the first containing release and matches the advisory pseudo-version boundary. Because the actual decomposed BIC commit object has a human identity and no AI marker, the only protocol-permitted conclusion is NOT_AI.
